title: Computational Strategies for Mixed Logit Estimation Automatic Differentiation, GPU Computing, and Floating-Point Precision
abstract: arXiv:2611.29833v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixed logit estimation can become computationally demanding as sample size and the dimension of preference heterogeneity increase. This study examines how derivative computation, processor choice and floating-point precision affect estimation time and parameter recovery across problem sizes. This paper provides a controlled benchmark, comparing finite differences (FD) with automatic differentiation (AD), central processing unit (CPU) execution with graphics processing unit (GPU) execution, and double-precision (FP64) with single-precision (FP32) arithmetic using Monte Carlo experiments that hold the data-generating process, simulation draws, optimiser, starting values, and objective function fixed across strategies.   The results show that AD is the dominant source of acceleration. translated_title: 混合Logit估计的计算策略：自动微分、GPU计算与浮点精度
translated_abstract: 随着样本量和偏好异质性维度的增加，混合Logit估计在计算上可能变得十分繁重。本研究考察了导数计算方式、处理器选择和浮点精度在不同问题规模下如何影响估计时间与参数恢复效果。本文提供了一个受控基准测试，通过蒙特卡洛实验比较有限差分法（FD）与自动微分（AD）、中央处理器（CPU）执行与图形处理器（GPU）执行、以及双精度（FP64）与单精度（FP32）算术，实验在各策略间保持数据生成过程、模拟抽样、优化器、起始值和目标函数不变。结果表明，自动微分（AD）是加速的主要来源。将AD与FP32算术结合可带来进一步提升，而将AD、GPU执行与FP32算术三者结合则能实现最大的速度改进。
tldr: 本文通过受控蒙特卡洛基准实验发现，自动微分是混合Logit估计加速的主要来源，而自动微分、GPU执行与单精度（FP32）算术三者结合可带来最大的速度提升。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a controlled Monte Carlo benchmark showing that automatic differentiation is the dominant source of acceleration in mixed logit estimation, with the combination of AD, GPU execution, and single-precision (FP32) arithmetic delivering the largest speed improvements.
